descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S24b Baseline survey dialog, handoff follow-up dialog, Settings feedback and the Nursing Home Post-Round task buttons pass axe

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 AC 5)
  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2; TFA-94514 AC 4; TFA-94609 AC 7)
  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3; TFA-94514 AC 5; TFA-94609 Spec 3)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15; a fresh account with seeded resident tasks, plus a colleague account for the send

When axe on the open Baseline survey dialog, the handoff follow-up dialog after a send, /settings Feedback, and the Nursing Home Post-Round tab with open tasks

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; both dialogs have accessible names; the rating buttons are a named radio group; Not now, Skip and Send feedback reachable by keyboard; every task button has an accessible name; tap targets >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations (serious/critical) = 0 and the name checks from visual-checks.ts. Known from the code read: the Nursing Home Post-Round task buttons (complete, delete) have no accessible name (src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:298-319)

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S24b is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-94514 ready for qa; TFA-94609 ready for pr

On the Nursing Home Post-Round task list each task's complete and delete buttons have no name, so VoiceOver reads only 'button, button'; the survey Yes / Start survey buttons fail contrast and the Handoff and Settings back/close buttons are unnamed.

Evidence: allure d9dd7696-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24b: 32 checks pass, 14 fail (axe button-name critical on the NH task buttons). Dialog names, the named radio group in Settings Feedback, and Tab reach for Not now / Skip / Send feedback pass. Recorded: the survey answer chips are not exposed as radio groups.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: visual.

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 32 judged check(s) passed, 14 failed. Baseline survey dialog ('Baseline survey', named), handoff follow-up dialog after a real send to a second fresh local account (generateHandoff mocked), Settings Feedback (named radio group), NH Post-Round with two open tasks. Not now, Skip and Send feedback are reached by Tab. The survey's answer chips are not exposed as radio groups (recorded).

Product issue: On the Nursing Home Post-Round task list each task's complete (□) and delete (trash) buttons have no accessible name — VoiceOver reads 'button, button' per task (oracle: every task button has an accessible name; also axe button-name critical). Plus contrast (white on teal Yes / Start survey) and the unnamed back/close buttons on the Handoff and Settings screens.

Evidence: 8 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24b — a folder (27 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the follow-up dialog also needs a handoff sent to a colleague account, and Send is refused on dev (runner-contract §10.4).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
